info.name: Sleuth Deployment & Impact Registration Deployments Manual Changes API

params.name: org_slug
params.description: URL-safe slug of your Sleuth organization.

params.name: project_slug
params.description: URL-safe slug of the project to register the change against.

items.docs: Registers a non-code, free-form manual change (feature flag flip, infrastructure change, config update, etc.) against a project so it appears on the deploy timeline. The api_key may be supplied in the Authorization header or in the request body, but not both.
